summary: acer aspire 7 gaming laptop has experienced thermal throttling and BSODs (Blue Screen of Death) issues due to its design. However, it still offers decent gaming performance with the RTX 2050 graphics card at a more affordable price point compared to the Lenovo LOQ option.
detected_fault: Thermal throttling and BSODs caused by laptop's design
suggested_solution: Use a cooling pad or adjust gaming settings to mitigate thermal issues, consider purchasing during Diwali sale or with student discounts for better deals.
